title: Claude 101

title: AI Fluency for Small Businesses
author: Anthropic

title: Get started with Claude Cowork

title: Use Claude Cowork safely
author: Anthropic Help Center
summary: Explains the actual safety model behind Cowork — isolated cloud execution, content classifiers, action screening — and gives concrete advice like blocking sensitive apps from folder access.

skip_if: Nothing — worth reading before your first real Cowork task regardless of experience level.
notes: Directly addresses the 'is this safe to point at my files' worry a nurse, HR manager, or lawyer would reasonably have.

title: Get started with Claude

title: Delegating your first task in Claude Cowork
